name: New Jersey

agency.name: New Jersey Division of Fish and Wildlife

notes: Dates are from the 2026-27 NJ Hunting & Trapping Digest. Deer are managed by zone with Regulation Sets that do not follow county lines, so deer seasons are shown statewide with a link to the zone chart.

rules.title: Sunday hunting
rules.text: No Sunday hunting for small game or turkey (limited exceptions, e.g. opossum and raccoon); see the digest for deer rules.

rules.title: Permits
rules.text: Spring turkey, bear and permit deer seasons require a permit (lottery or zone-specific).

items.label: Six-day firearm season
items.note: Zone/Regulation Set determines limits and permits; see the digest.

items.label: Permit bow, shotgun & muzzleloader seasons
items.note: Need a zone-specific antlerless permit; dates vary by zone — see the deer regulations chart.

items.label: Fall & winter bow (no zone permit)
items.note: Dates vary by zone — see the deer regulations chart.

items.label: Spring turkey — Period Y (ages 10–16)
items.note: Hours to noon through May 15, then to sunset. Permit lottery; 1 male turkey per permit.

items.label: Spring turkey — Period A
items.note: Permit lottery; no Sunday turkey hunting.

items.label: Gray squirrel, rabbit, jackrabbit & hare
items.note: Closed Dec 7–12 and Dec 16. No Sunday hunting except opossum and raccoon.

items.label: Stocked quail
items.note: Wild quail and grouse seasons are closed.
